value_updates.headline: Create a Personalized Vehicle Sales Page the Easiest Way
value_updates.supporting_copy:
Record a walkaround video with your phone, then include photos, a personal note, and useful dealership links. LOTCLIP turns that content into a professional vehicle sales page in under a minute, ready for you to text or email to the customer.

Your customer gets everything in a single place: the video, vehicle photos, Carfax, window sticker, quote, trade appraisal, and more. There’s no need for editing software or a computer—just a straightforward tool designed for busy automotive salespeople.
